description: This file defines a Python class 'GoogleAIStudioInteractionsConfig' that provides configuration and transformation methods for interacting with the Google AI Studio Interactions API, following the OpenAPI specification. It includes utilities for building API URLs, transforming requests and responses, handling streaming data, and managing interaction lifecycle operations such as get, delete, and cancel.

classes.name: GoogleAIStudioInteractionsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Google AI Studio Interactions API, providing methods to construct URLs, validate environment, transform requests and responses, and handle interaction lifecycle operations.

methods.description: Returns the LlmProviders enum value indicating GEMINI as the provider.

methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for interactions endpoint, including API key and optional streaming parameter.

methods.name: Dict transform_request( self, model: Optional[str], agent: Optional[str], input: Optional[InteractionInput], optional_params: InteractionsAPIOptionalRequestParams, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )

methods.name: InteractionsAPIResponse transform_response( self, model: Optional[str], raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Parses the raw HTTP response into an InteractionsAPIResponse object, adding header info.

methods.name: InteractionsAPIStreamingResponse transform_streaming_response( self, model: Optional[str], parsed_chunk: dict, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Parses streaming response chunks into InteractionsAPIStreamingResponse objects.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_get_interaction_request( self, interaction_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Builds URL and headers for GET request to retrieve an interaction by ID.

methods.name: InteractionsAPIResponse transform_get_interaction_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Parses response from GET interaction request.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_delete_interaction_request( self, interaction_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Builds URL and headers for DELETE request to remove an interaction.
